ceremony.name: KW-to-VTI task-consent: an executor holds a gated task, approvers decide
ceremony.choreography: docs/27-kw-vti-ceremonies.md section 2: the requester submits a gated task, the executor refuses it for consent and asks its approvers, each approver's decision (built and signed by the approver's own code) is relayed back, the requester re-submits and the executor executes once. The steps are the same whichever executor (the reference oracle, a VTA) and whichever approver (the reference, the wallet) plays.

TF specs/task-consent/decision/0.2/spec.md (the decision echoes the challenge and payloadDigest of the request; its proof by the approver's own DID is the authorization)
docs/27-kw-vti-ceremonies.md section 2 (the choreography and its stand-ins)
